lines.text: Zion's light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises on her while thick darkness covers the peoples.
The riches of the sea will come to Zion, and camels of Midian and Ephah will bring gold and myrrh.
The ships of Tarshish will lead in bringing Zion's children from afar, and foreigners will rebuild her walls.
Cypress, elm and boxwood from Lebanon will adorn the sanctuary, and those who reviled Zion will call her the City of Palms.
The LORD will bring silver instead of iron, and He will be Zion's everlasting light instead of the sun.
